ticker: Ambani's Jio Explores Comcast & Charter Tech Talks
Fairfax's IDBI Bank Deal Faces Opposition
Super Micro Forecasts Strong AI Server Revenue
Binance Hackers Used Fake Job Interview in $6.3B Attack

articles.headline: Jio Explores Tech-For-Equity Talks With Comcast And Charter
articles.brief: Ambani's Reliance Jio is reportedly exploring tech-for-equity discussions with US telecom giants Comcast and Charter, according to industry sources familiar with the ongoing strategic exploratory talks.

articles.headline: Super Micro Forecasts Strong Quarterly Revenue On AI Demand
articles.brief: Super Micro Computer has forecasted quarterly revenue above Wall Street estimates, driven by an accelerating global demand for advanced artificial intelligence server infrastructure.

articles.headline: Fairfax's $5.5 Billion IDBI Bank Bid Faces Opposition
articles.brief: Fairfax’s proposed $5.5 billion acquisition of India's IDBI Bank has encountered significant employee pushback and political resistance, creating hurdles for the mega financial transaction.

articles.headline: India's Gold Demand Projected To Fall To Six-Year Low
articles.brief: India's gold demand is anticipated to drop to a six-year low as continuous price surges cool retail buying sentiment across the world's second-biggest consumer market.

articles.headline: Spain's Transport Minister Resigns Following Deadly Train Crash
articles.brief: Spain's transport minister announced his immediate resignation in the wake of another deadly train crash that has sparked nationwide outrage and intense safety scrutiny.

articles.headline: US Midterm Elections 2026 Begin With Control of Congress at Stake
articles.brief: Voters head to the polls across the United States for the 2026 midterm elections, which will decide control of both the House and Senate amid high-stakes political tension.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rules Right to Protest Doesn't Justify Endless Occupation
articles.brief: India's Supreme Court ruled that the fundamental right to protest cannot be used to justify the indefinite and disruptive occupation of public spaces and sites.

articles.headline: Air India Seeks More Wide-Body Jets, Eyes Near-Term Profitability
articles.brief: Air India CEO announced that the airline is aggressively pursuing additional wide-body aircraft orders and expects to achieve sustainable profitability in the very near future.

articles.headline: India Faces Prolonged Food Inflation Across Grains, Milk and Chicken
articles.brief: Persistent domestic supply chain challenges and erratic weather patterns have left India grappling with stubborn, prolonged food inflation affecting staples from grains to poultry and milk.

articles.headline: Binance Hackers Exploited Fake Job Interviews in $6.3B Breach
articles.brief: Investigators reveal that hackers targeted cryptocurrency exchange Binance using sophisticated fake job interview ploys as an entry vector in a massive $6.3 billion security breach.

articles.headline: Cyclone Murasu Makes Landfall Along India's Eastern Coast
articles.brief: Cyclone Murasu has officially made landfall on India's eastern coast, prompting emergency evacuations, disaster response deployments, and heavy rainfall alerts across coastal districts.

articles.headline: Authorities Seize And Destroy 7,000 Kg of Unhygienic Khoya in Delhi
articles.brief: Delhi authorities seized and destroyed 7,000 kilograms of foul-smelling, unhygienic khoya after dozens of preliminary food safety tests failed at mobile testing checkpoints.

articles.headline: Indian Drugmakers May Face Mandatory Batch Certification Experts
articles.brief: India's booming $60 billion pharmaceutical industry faces stricter regulatory requirements, potentially necessitating designated certified experts to oversee batch releases before market sale.

articles.headline: Bracewell Anticipates Even Contests in Upcoming One-Day Cricket Series
articles.brief: Ahead of upcoming limited-overs fixtures, coach Bracewell highlighted the evolving tactical challenges spinners face and expects balanced, highly competitive contests in ODI cricket.

articles.headline: NASCAR Driver Carson Hocevar Suspended After Martinsville Incident
articles.brief: Spire Motorsports has suspended NASCAR driver Carson Hocevar following aggressive driving maneuvers and repeated brake-checking directed at Austin Cindric during the Martinsville race.
